description: Ministry of Justice Prison Affairs and Constitutional Reforms - Judicature Act, No. 2 of 1978, Order Under Sub Section (2) of Section 29 A
reasoning: This gazette content is a legal/regulatory notification that amends the monetary jurisdiction limits for court actions under the Judicature Act, No. 2 of 1978. It contains a statutory instrument (Order) issued by the Minister of Justice under specific legal authority (subsection (2) of Section 29 A), modifying the Seventh Schedule of the Act. While it mentions a minister's name and title, this is incidental to the primary purpose of publishing a legal amendment, making it a Legal/Regulatory Gazette rather than a government personnel or hybrid classification.
